info.name: Bloom Express API — private optional cloud backup
info.description: Runs locally with fictional aliases and an actual browser-encrypted fictional diary. No real health data or personal credentials belong in this collection. Collection order matters: register two disposable users, verify isolation and revisions, then delete both accounts. Run against a disposable test database whenever possible. The server validates the encrypted envelope shape; only the browser can verify/decrypt its content.

item.name: 05 Reject plaintext age and contact registration fields

exec: pm.test('Personal fields are rejected without being reflected', () => { pm.expect(body.error.code).to.equal('BODY_INVALID'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('fictional@example.invalid'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('2009-01-01'); });

pm.test('HttpOnly session cookie', () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); pm.expect(c).to.include('HttpOnly'); pm.expect(c).to.match(/SameSite=Strict/i); pm.expect(c).to.include('Path=/api'); });

pm.test('HttpOnly session cookie', () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); pm.expect(c).to.include('HttpOnly'); pm.expect(c).to.match(/SameSite=Strict/i); pm.expect(c).to.include('Path=/api'); });

exec: pm.test('HttpOnly session cookie', () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); pm.expect(c).to.include('HttpOnly'); pm.expect(c).to.match(/SameSite=Strict/i); pm.expect(c).to.include('Path=/api'); });
pm.test('A fresh CSRF token is issued', () => pm.expect(body.data.csrfToken).not.to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('previousSessionCsrf')));

item.name: 39 Returning account session retains its alias

exec: pm.test('Returning session has the same identity', () => { pm.expect(body.data.user.id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('userAId')); pm.expect(body.data.user.username).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('userA')); pm.expect(body.data.csrfToken).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('csrfToken')); });
pm.test('Age and contact details are absent from session metadata', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(body.data.user).sort()).to.deep.equal(['id', 'username']));

item.name: 40 Returning user keeps the encrypted diary snapshot

exec: pm.test('Re-login preserves the exact encrypted diary', () => pm.expect(body.data.backup).to.deep.equal(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('encryptedBackup'))));

pm.test('Age stays inside the encrypted backup', () => { pm.expect(body.data).not.to.have.property('profile'); pm.expect(body.data.backup).not.to.have.property('ageGroup'); pm.expect(body.data.backup).not.to.have.property('dateOfBirth'); });
